probes.query: Two clients concurrently change the same single-valued field of the same node. Where is the key that makes these two writes clash produced, and which component finally decides that one of them must be aborted?
expectedFacts: The clash key is built from a farm fingerprint of the data key; for a non-list predicate it is XORed with uid 0, so two different values written to the same node+predicate collide.
For list predicates the value fingerprint is XORed in, so different values do not conflict; predicates with a no-conflict schema directive produce no key.
The keys travel to the cluster coordinator (Zero) in the transaction context as base-36 strings.
